notes.title: Big Demo Update
notes.notes:
The latest build 17491883 introduce a big change to the upgrade of buildings.

Major Changes
- Removed the purchasing of upgrades level caps
- Now each building has an elemental type among Air, Fire, Water, Lightning. Each building also has an influence pattern of surrounding slots each with a preference for an elemental type. Placing a building of the corresponding type in the appropriate slot upgrades the building.
- Each building now can be interacted with showing a UI that reports the current level, production per second and enabled the relocation of the building

Minor Changes
- Level up visual effects and sounds
- Volume sliders

Fixes
- Fixed the gathering tool not colliding with gatherables on certain occasions.

Thank you for your support in providing precious feedback.
